::: {.column width="63%"}
I'm Martinas Jucys Brady, a final-year Business Studies International student at DCU specialising in data analytics and studying Japanese. Most of what I've worked on during the degree has sat between business, data, and language. This page is a quick rundown of the modules I've taken, the things I do outside of university, and the skills I've picked up along the way.
:::

::::
